statement:
∀ (F : ℕ → KdVPlan.Coeff) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff),
 KdVPlan.SeqConv 0 F f → KdVPlan.SeqConv 0 F g → f = g
proof:
intro F f g hf hg
ext k
by_contra hk
have hp : 0 < ‖f k-g k‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hk)
obtain ⟨mf,hmf⟩ := hf.2 (‖f k-g k‖/4) (by positivity)
obtain ⟨mg,hmg⟩ := hg.2 (‖f k-g k‖/4) (by positivity)
let n := max mf mg
have h₁ := hmf n (le_max_left _ _)
have h₂ := hmg n (le_max_right _ _)
have hb₁ := ((@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T002 h_T003 h_T017 h_T013 (F n-f) h₁.1).2 k).trans h₁.2
have hb₂ := ((@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T002 h_T003 h_T017 h_T013 (F n-g) h₂.1).2 k).trans h₂.2
have ht : ‖f k-g k‖ ≤ ‖F n k-f k‖+‖F n k-g k‖ := by
  calc
    _ = ‖-(F n k-f k)+(F n k-g k)‖ := by congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ ‖-(F n k-f k)‖+‖F n k-g k‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [norm_neg]
change ‖F n k-f k‖ ≤ _ at hb₁
change ‖F n k-g k‖ ≤ _ at hb₂
linarith
